chapter.title: PROVISIONS AS TO OFFENCES AFFECTING THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE

heading: When Registrar or Sub-Registrar to be deemed a Civil Court.
text: When the State Government so directs, any Registrar or any Sub-Registrar appointed under the [1]* * * Registration Act, 1908 (16 of 1908), shall be deemed to be a Civil Court within the meaning of sections 345 and 346.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: The word “Indian” omitted by Act 56 of 1974, s. 3 and the Second Sch. (w.e.f. 20-12-1974).
